stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million seed round for AI sensors
stories.summary: Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in a seed round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures. The Delhi-based company plans to develop chips for physical AI machines. It is one of the largest funding rounds in this segment.

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million for programmable AI sensors
stories.summary: Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in an all-equity seed round to develop programmable image sensors that process AI at the edge. The company plans to use the capital for engineering recruitment and product development. It intends to perform AI inference closer to where images are captured.

stories.title: Olyv raises $6 million to expand financial services
stories.summary: Fintech startup Olyv has raised $6 million from Nippon Life India AIF Management Ltd and existing investors. The company plans to move beyond digital personal loans into a broader financial services ecosystem. It aims to address credit access for borrowers who lack conventional income documentation.

stories.title: Karta AI raises $3 million in seed funding
stories.summary: Karta AI has raised 28.52 crore rupees in a seed round led by Peer Capital and Cedar Hill Capital. The startup builds AI-powered voice agents for banks and fintech companies. It plans to use the capital to expand distribution and strengthen its predictive content team.

stories.title: Dhruva Space raises 147 crore rupees in pre-Series B round
stories.summary: Dhruva Space is set to raise 147 crore rupees in a pre-Series B round led by IndusBridge Ventures. The company will issue preference shares to investors including the government-backed Antariksh Venture Capital Fund. This follows a 60 crore rupee investment in the company earlier this year.

stories.title: Arborum Labs raises pre-seed funding for world models
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Arborum Labs has raised an undisclosed pre-seed round co-led by Speciale Invest and Ideaspring Capital. The startup is developing world models for complex infrastructure networks. It plans to use the capital to accelerate product development and expand its commercial presence in India and internationally.

stories.title: Wealthtech startup finny.club raises 5.3 crore rupees
stories.summary: Wealthtech startup finny.club has raised 5.3 crore rupees in an angel round to expand its AI-powered financial advisory platform. The company aims to help salaried Indians achieve financial independence. It plans to use the funds to strengthen its product development and expand its advisory team.

stories.title: Redbrick Offices raises 630 crore rupees in equity
stories.summary: Redbrick Offices has raised 630 crore rupees across its Series A and A1 funding rounds. The company plans to expand its managed offices portfolio from 6.5 million to more than 10 million square feet. It intends to invest in technology and service delivery for enterprise clients.

stories.title: Xpressbees raises 100 crore rupees in debt
stories.summary: Logistics company Xpressbees has raised 100 crore rupees from BlackSoil through the issue of non-convertible debentures. The debt carries a 13.5 percent coupon over 36 months. The company intends to use the capital to fund its working capital needs.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million at $3.5 billion valuation
stories.summary: Genesis AI has raised $500 million in Series A funding at a $3.5 billion valuation. The startup teaches robots to perform tasks by learning from human movements. It is currently targeting factories and warehouses, bringing its total disclosed funding to $605 million since its 2024 inception.

stories.title: Luminal secures $25 million in Series A funding
stories.summary: AI cloud startup Luminal has raised $25 million in a Series A round led by Standard Capital. The company is building a search compiler to optimize models for GPUs. It aims to enable users to rely on a wider range of hardware beyond Nvidia.

stories.title: Dreamteam raises $53 million for AI-native CRM
stories.summary: AI-native CRM platform Dreamteam has emerged from stealth mode with $53 million in funding from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest. The startup aims to disrupt the CRM software category. It did not elaborate on how it plans to utilize the new capital.

stories.title: Dreamteam emerges from stealth with $53 million
stories.summary: Dreamteam has raised $53 million from Accel, Together Fund and Premji Invest to build AI-native CRM software. The startup is developing AI teammates that learn from customer conversations to automate sales workflows. It aims to replace manual data entry processes used by traditional CRM platforms.

stories.title: Science Corporation valued at $3.5 billion after funding
stories.summary: Science Corporation has raised $400 million in a Series D round, valuing the company at $3.5 billion. Founded by former Neuralink president Max Hodak, the startup develops medical technology to interact with the brain. Its first product is an implantable chip designed for vision.

stories.title: Cybersecurity startup Corma reaches $1 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Corma has raised $125 million in a Series A round at a $1 billion valuation. The company offers AI models trained for defense and came out of stealth in August. It has raised $185 million total following recent security flaws in popular programming languages.

stories.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion
stories.summary: London-based AI drug discovery company Isomorphic Labs has raised $5 billion in fresh funding. The round comes six months after its previous raise as investors continue to back startups targeting the pharmaceutical industry. The company is backed by Sequoia and A16z.

stories.title: Remanence raises $30 million seed round
stories.summary: Paris-based startup Remanence has raised a $30 million seed round backed by EQT and FirstMark. Cofounded by H Company alumni, the startup aims to help businesses post-train open-weight AI models. It intends to assist companies in deploying these models for their specific business needs.

stories.title: Roadzen announces $10 million financing
stories.summary: Roadzen has raised $10 million in common-equity financing for its India subsidiary at a $300 million valuation. The Nasdaq-listed parent company says the issuance avoids direct dilution. Roadzen is targeting a $100 million annual revenue run-rate while projecting growth for its VehicleCare unit.

stories.title: Oister Global launches ₹600 crore deeptech fund
stories.summary: Oister Global has launched a growth-stage deeptech fund targeting a ₹600 crore corpus. The firm intends to build a concentrated portfolio of 8-10 companies across sectors like spacetech and semiconductors. It will focus on mature startups that have already developed commercially viable technologies and are looking to scale.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund for India and beyond
stories.summary: US-based Norwest has closed a $4 billion fund to target investments in India, the US and Israel. The firm plans to focus on value-added manufacturing, healthcare and artificial intelligence. It typically invests between $30 million and $150 million in growth-stage companies to fuel their expansion.

stories.title: Taisei Corporation starts $150 million construction CVC fund
stories.summary: Japanese construction firm Taisei Corporation has launched a $150 million corporate venture capital fund to invest in autonomous machinery and humanoid robots. Managed by Pegasus Tech Ventures, the ten-year fund aims to improve construction productivity and create new growth sources for the 153-year-old company.

stories.title: Plural raises €1 billion for frontier tech
stories.summary: Plural has raised a €1 billion venture capital fund for early-stage European startups in energy, AI, robotics and space. The firm, led by six partners with operating backgrounds, plans to reserve capital for follow-on investments. This is a sharp increase from its €260 million inaugural fund in 2022.

stories.title: Plural splits new $1.1 billion fund into two buckets
stories.summary: Plural has raised €1 billion in new capital, with two-thirds allocated to its third early-stage fund and one-third to a new opportunities fund for follow-on investments. The firm remains committed to early-stage moonshots, though some will require larger checks than previously anticipated by the venture capital firm.

stories.title: Sofinnova Partners closes €725 million crossover fund
stories.summary: Sofinnova Partners has closed its second crossover fund at €725 million, exceeding its original target. The firm will focus on European clinical-stage biopharma and medtech companies seeking capital to advance toward commercialization. It aims to back late-stage life sciences companies with the potential to become global leaders.

stories.title: Cyberstarts raises $360 million across two new funds
stories.summary: Israeli venture capital firm Cyberstarts has raised $360 million across two new vehicles. This includes a $300 million fund dedicated to cybersecurity company Cyera, which is reportedly seeking an $800 million funding round at a $20 billion valuation, alongside a $60 million seed fund.

stories.title: Overmatch Ventures raises $250 million for Fund II
stories.summary: Overmatch Ventures has raised $250 million for its second fund. The firm, which invests in deep tech, defense and space, plans to use the larger capital pool to lead investment rounds and write bigger initial checks for its portfolio companies.

stories.title: Sofinnova Partners closes second life sciences fund
stories.summary: Sofinnova Partners has closed its second life sciences crossover fund at €725 million. The firm, which operates out of Paris, London and Milan, focuses on clinical-stage biopharma and medtech companies. The close follows exits from its first fund including LimFlow, Calliditas and Amolyt.

stories.title: Rediff files updated papers for ₹600 crore IPO
stories.summary: Rediff has filed updated draft papers for a ₹600 crore initial public offering. The company intends to use the capital to expand its enterprise solutions, digital payments and video platforms. It previously filed confidential papers in April 2026 with an estimated issue size of ₹600-800 crore.

stories.title: Coal India subsidiary MCL sets IPO for diversification
stories.summary: Coal India is offering a 10 percent stake in its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields through an IPO to raise ₹8,981 crore. The parent company will use the proceeds to finance a ₹1 trillion diversification program into coal gasification and renewable energy. The subsidiary receives no new capital.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields sets price band for ₹8,981 crore IPO
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has fixed its IPO price band at ₹129-136 per share. The state-run Coal India subsidiary expects a post-listing market capitalization of ₹90,009 crore at the upper end of the band. The issue opens for subscription on November 19 and closes on November 23.

stories.title: Perplexity eyes Q1 2027 IPO
stories.summary: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas said the company may file for an IPO as early as the first quarter of 2027. The company claims to have reached $1 billion in annual recurring revenue, surpassing its $750 million target. The timeline was previously set for 2028.

stories.title: Meganet Technologies files for $78.6 million IPO
stories.summary: Indian AI infrastructure provider Meganet Technologies has filed draft papers for an IPO to raise 7.4 billion rupees. The company manufactures hardware for data centers and brokerages. It plans to deploy the capital to fund growth amid the ongoing artificial intelligence boom.

stories.title: Airtel Payments Bank profit rises 139 percent
stories.summary: Airtel Payments Bank reported a net profit of ₹28.2 crore for the second quarter, up from ₹11.8 crore in the same period last year. The company attributed the growth to rising revenues and improved margins. It also claimed to have crossed ₹3,500 crore in annualised revenue.

stories.title: Fairfax to sell 13.25 percent stake in IIFL Finance
stories.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings plans to sell its entire 13.25 percent stake in IIFL Finance through a block deal on November 18. The sale is expected to fetch up to ₹3,454 crore. The firm is liquidating the holding to unlock funds for its acquisition of IDBI Bank.

stories.title: Rasna withdraws insolvency process after settlement
stories.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal has allowed Rasna Private Limited to withdraw its insolvency resolution process. The beverage concentrate manufacturer reached a settlement with its operational creditor, Bharat Road Carrier Private Limited. The withdrawal application was filed by the interim resolution professional.

stories.title: Ranveer Singh and Aman Gupta launch H.I.M brand
stories.summary: Actor Ranveer Singh and boAt cofounder Aman Gupta have launched a men's personal care brand called H.I.M. The products are priced between ₹299 and ₹899 and feature a proprietary molecule called IN·XT. The brand is available on Amazon, Blinkit and its own website.

stories.title: Param wins robot race as startups display India's AI-powered machines
stories.summary: Homegrown companies showcased autonomous quadruped robots at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026. The demonstration featured four-legged machines navigating a specially designed track to highlight India's growing capabilities in robotics and Physical AI. The robots were required to complete a lap and return to the starting point.

stories.title: From hobby to startup: Udupi entrepreneur opens drone experience centre
stories.summary: Devash K. Hegade, founder of Fly Camp, has opened what he describes as India's first drone experience centre. The facility allows people with no prior experience to fly drones and learn about the technology. The startup evolved from Hegade's personal interest in drones during his engineering studies.

stories.title: OpenAI hires Pragya Misra to lead India, South Asia business development ahead of IPO plans
Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a curated educational video platform for kids
stories.summary: Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a platform for educational videos. Green described his motivation as a response to the degradation of the internet, which he says has been taken over by terrible vibes and algorithms selecting for outrage. He aims to provide an alternative to the current landscape.

stories.title: Meesho CEO buys Bengaluru villa plots from Byju Raveendran’s family
stories.summary: Vidit Aatrey, CEO of Meesho, purchased two luxury residential villa plots in Bengaluru for 83.81 crore rupees. The plots were sold by family members of Byju Raveendran, the co-founder of BYJU's. The transactions were completed on 24 July 2026 through two separate sale deeds.

stories.title: Kunal Bahl on how an H-1B visa rejection led to Snapdeal
stories.summary: Kunal Bahl co-founded Snapdeal and Titan Capital after his H-1B visa was rejected while working at Microsoft. Bahl was asked to return to India and reapply for the visa later, but he chose to pursue entrepreneurship instead. He now views the rejection as a career catalyst.

stories.title: Kunal Bahl on his journey from H-1B rejection to Shark Tank
stories.summary: Kunal Bahl, co-founder of AceVector Limited and Titan Capital, says his H-1B visa rejection fast-tracked his path to entrepreneurship. After graduating from the University of Pennsylvania, Bahl returned to India to build his businesses. He is now a judge on Shark Tank India.

stories.title: Friends from Coimbatore build GOAT Robotics into an 8 crore business
stories.summary: GOAT Robotics, founded by nine engineering graduates in Coimbatore, has grown from a 10 lakh rupee turnover to over 8 crore rupees. The company pivoted from hotel robots to industrial automation and now provides services internationally. It currently spends 40 lakh rupees per month on staff salaries.

research.title: Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design

Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
